title: Date Filled Kneaded Pastry
description: A simple and sweet pastry filled with chopped dates, kneaded to perfection. A perfect dessert for a warm evening.
instructions: 2. In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, sugar, and salt. Mix well.
3. Add the softened butter and mix until the dough resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Beat in the egg and vanilla extract.
5. Knead the dough on a floured surface until smooth and elastic.
6. Divide the dough into 2 equal portions.
7. Roll out each portion into a thin sheet.
8. Place a tablespoon of chopped dates in the center of each sheet.
9. Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges to seal.
10. Place the pastries on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
11. Brush the tops with a little water and sprinkle with granulated sugar.
12. Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
